retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, desaturated portrait featuring tactile glitter typography and distressed, scratched borders for a gritty pop aesthetic.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, close-up portrait of a person with desaturated skin and heavy eye makeup, framed by a rough, white distressed border. The composition is defined by the contrast between the dark, moody photography and the vibrant, sparkling glitter textures applied to the lips and the hand-drawn style typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Glitter texture on lips mirrors the glitter texture of the display typography
High-contrast lighting creates a halo effect around the hair against a dark background
Distressed white border contains the desaturated central portrait
Rough, hand-drawn letterforms contrast with the photographic realism
coreInvariants: Tactile, chunky glitter texture on all graphic overlays
Heavy desaturation of skin tones with high-contrast shadows
Distressed, scratched, and uneven white frame border

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, centered portrait filling the majority of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes and gold glitter lips serve as the primary focal points.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top-left glitter text, down to the subject's eyes, then to the glitter lips, and finally to the bottom-right text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the subject and border occupy almost the entire square format.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated grayscale and deep blacks in the portrait and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white used for the distressed border and highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold glitter and purple/pink glitter for text and lip accents.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with low saturation in the image, punctuated by high-saturation glitter accents.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Hand-drawn, jagged sans-serif with irregular stroke widths.
letterConstructionRules: Jagged, shaky outlines suggesting hand-drawn marker or paint
Inclusion of symbols like dollar signs within the letterforms
Thick, chunky glitter fill that obscures fine detail
characterSpecificRedesigns: S replaced with a stylized dollar sign
A has a wide, low crossbar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between two different glitter colors (gold vs. purple) for primary and secondary text.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the jagged, DIY punk aesthetic of the lettering
Essential for the tactile, glamorous-yet-gritty look

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, desaturated close-up portrait of a person with heavy dark eye makeup and gold glitter lips, set against a dark background with a white distressed, scratched film border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply hand-drawn, jagged uppercase lettering with a thick gold glitter texture in the top left, and similar lettering with a purple glitter texture in the bottom right.

verificationChecks: Is the border sufficiently distressed and white?
Does the glitter texture look chunky and tactile?
Is the portrait desaturated with high contrast?
Is the dollar sign integrated into the top text?

postGenerationChecks: Check that glitter texture is present on both text and lips
Ensure the border looks like damaged physical film
Verify the portrait is centered and fills the frame
Confirm the dollar sign is used in the primary text
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast desaturated portrait + gold glitter lips + distressed white border + hand-drawn glitter typography.
